cues.en: Hello, my friends, and welcome to the very last hands-on tutorial of the CodePipeline series.
cues.zh: 朋友們好，歡迎來到 CodePipeline 系列最後實作。

cues.en: After covering CodePipeline and CodeBuild, now is the time to finish on a good note with CodeDeploy.
cues.zh: CodePipeline、CodeBuild 後，使用 CodeDeploy 收尾。

cues.en: Indeed, that's the last step of the pipeline.
cues.zh: 是管線最後一步。

cues.en: After we build a model, of course, we deploy it, just like what we did in the previous sections on model development and then model deployment.
cues.zh: 建模型後部署，像先前開發、部署章節。

cues.en: And so here we go.
cues.zh: 開始。

cues.en: Let's go to the search bar and let's enter CodeDeploy.
cues.zh: 搜尋 CodeDeploy。

cues.en: All right, CodeDeploy to automate code deployments and welcome to CodeDeploy, AWS CodeDeploy automate code deployments to maintain application uptime.
cues.zh: 自動化程式部署，維持應用運作時間，歡迎來到 AWS CodeDeploy。

cues.en: It is a fully managed, once again, deployment service that automates software deployments to compute services, such as Amazon EC2, AWS Lambda, and your on-premises servers.
cues.zh: 同樣全受管，自動部署軟體到 EC2、Lambda、地端伺服器等運算服務。

cues.en: AWS CodeDeploy makes it easy for you to rapidly release new features, helps you avoid downtime during application deployment, and handles the complexity of updating your applications.
cues.zh: 快速發布新功能，避免部署停機，處理更新複雜度。

cues.en: I recommend watching this YouTube video, it's pretty well made, it will never hurt for the exam.
cues.zh: 推薦這段 YouTube，做得很好，對考試有幫助。

cues.en: And now, together, we will create the application and then do the different steps of creating a deployment in CodeDeploy, but without deploying any machinery model, of course,
cues.zh: 接著建立應用，再看部署步驟，但當然不部署模型，

cues.en: because this would require to build a new one, and after this long and laborious tutorial on CodeBuild, well, we won't build a new model, but no worries.
cues.zh: 否則需重建；CodeBuild 已很長、費工，不再建新模型，但別擔心。

cues.en: I'll show you the steps and you will see this will be way enough for the exam.
cues.zh: 看步驟就足夠考試。

cues.en: Okay, so application name, well, let's keep things simple, let's call it "Machine Learning Application," so that we can recognize easily what we are creating.
cues.zh: 應用名稱簡單叫 Machine Learning Application，方便辨認。

cues.en: Compute platform.
cues.zh: 運算平台。

cues.en: Well, you have the choice between, as we just saw in the description, EC2 or on-premises servers, AWS Lambda, or Amazon ECS, Elastic Container Service.
cues.zh: 可 EC2／On-premises、AWS Lambda、Amazon ECS。

cues.en: So let's choose for example, EC2 on-premises, and then, very easily, you create your application, okay?
cues.zh: 例如選 EC2／On-premises，很容易就建應用。

cues.en: So that's the simple step, and then the next step is to create a deployment group.
cues.zh: 下一步建 Deployment group。

cues.en: Indeed, in order to create a deployment, you first need to create a deployment group because any deployment must belong to a deployment group.
cues.zh: 因為每個部署都必須屬於群組。

cues.en: All right, so once again, to keep things simple and recognize elements easily, let's call our deployment group "Machine Learning Deployment Group," okay?
cues.zh: 同樣簡單命名 Machine Learning Deployment Group。

cues.en: Perfect, Machine Learning Deployment Group, then service role.
cues.zh: 很好，再 Service role。

cues.en: Indeed, in order to create a deployment group, you have to enter a service role, which we don't have yet.
cues.zh: 必須填服務角色，目前沒有。

cues.en: We won't create a new one in IM, but I'll just show you how to find the ARN of an IM role with, for example, the service role for CodeBuild that was created automatically in the AM
cues.zh: 不去 IAM 建新的，只展示怎麼找 ARN，例如 CodeBuild 在 IAM 自動建立的角色，

cues.en: in the presentorial.
cues.zh: 就在上一堂。

cues.en: So let me just show you that quickly.
cues.zh: 快速展示。

cues.en: In the search bar, I'm gonna enter IM, I'm gonna enter IM in a new tab, and we'll just find the role for CodeBuild and I'll just show you how to find easily the ARN, okay?
cues.zh: 新分頁搜尋 IAM，找 CodeBuild 角色，展示 ARN 位置。

cues.en: So let's go into the roles here, either here or here, okay?
cues.zh: 到 Roles，這裡或這裡都可。

cues.en: And there it is.
cues.zh: 在這裡。

cues.en: That's the IM role that was automatically created when, remember, we build that machinery model in CodeBuild, okay?
cues.zh: 記得 CodeBuild 建模型時自動建立的 IAM 角色。

cues.en: So you go to your role, you enter your role, and very easily, you will find the ARN here, okay?
cues.zh: 進角色，很容易找到 ARN。

cues.en: So let's suppose that's the role allowing CodeDeploy access, so I'm gonna copy it, and then back into CodeDeploy,
cues.zh: 假設這個角色允許 CodeDeploy，先複製，回 CodeDeploy，

cues.en: well, we're gonna enter the ARN of our service role, okay?
cues.zh: 填服務角色 ARN。

cues.en: Perfect, deployment type then.
cues.zh: 很好，Deployment type。

cues.en: You have the choice between in place, which will update the instances in the deployment group with the latest application revisions.
cues.zh: 可 In-place，以最新應用修訂更新群組執行個體。

cues.en: During a deployment, each instance will be briefly taken offline for its update.
cues.zh: 更新時各執行個體會短暫離線。

cues.en: Or blue/green deployment, which will replace the instances in the deployment group with new instances and deploys the latest application revision to them.
cues.zh: 或 Blue/green，用新執行個體替換原本的，部署最新修訂。

cues.en: That's actually very important for the exam.
cues.zh: 考試非常重要。

cues.en: Try to remember this. Blue/green can come up at the exam.
cues.zh: 記得，可能會考藍綠。

cues.en: I remember I had some deployment-type questions involving blue/green in my exam.
cues.zh: 我考試就遇過。

cues.en: And then after, instances in the replacement environment are registered with a load balancer and instances from the original environment are deregistered and can be terminated, okay?
cues.zh: 新環境執行個體註冊到負載平衡器，原環境取消註冊，可終止。

cues.en: Very important to remember this.
cues.zh: 很重要。

cues.en: So let's keep in place, then environment configuration.
cues.zh: 保留 In-place，再 Environment configuration。

cues.en: Here, you can select any combination of either EC2 auto scaling groups, or EC2 instances simply, or on-premises instances to add to your deployment, okay?
cues.zh: 可任意組合 EC2 Auto Scaling groups、EC2 instances、On-premises instances。

cues.en: So for example, let's imagine we just choose a combination of EC2 instances and auto-scaling groups, right?
cues.zh: 假設選 EC2 與自動擴展群組。

cues.en: Always good to have automatic scaling.
cues.zh: 自動擴展很好。

cues.en: And so here, you would select up to 10 auto scaling groups, which, of course, we don't have here because we haven't created anything in EC2, and here below, well, that's where you would select
cues.zh: 這裡最多選 10 個群組，目前沒建，所以沒有；下方可選

cues.en: different Amazon EC2 instances, which would be in EC2, but once again, we haven't created any instance in EC2, so we have nothing here, but I'm just showing you the steps here
cues.zh: EC2 執行個體，也沒建，所以空白，只展示步驟，

cues.en: so that at least you can understand how CodeDeploy works, and therefore, smash any practical question at the exam.
cues.zh: 理解 CodeDeploy，方便回答實作考題。

cues.en: Okay, then let's crawl down, and here, well, that's the agent configuration with AWS Systems Manager.
cues.zh: 往下，是 AWS Systems Manager 的 Agent 設定。

cues.en: Basically, you can install AWS CodeDeploy agent, which is basically like an AI agent that will assist you with all your CodeDeploy deployments, okay?
cues.zh: 可安裝 CodeDeploy agent；講者比喻為協助部署的 AI agent。

cues.en: And finally, in the deployment settings, well, you can select a deployment configuration between all at once, one at a time, or half at a time, okay?
cues.zh: Deployment settings 可 All at once、One at a time、Half at a time。

cues.en: So let's keep all at once.
cues.zh: 保留 All at once。

cues.en: And finally, you can choose to enable or disable load balancing, so let's keep load balancing, and there you go.
cues.zh: 最後可啟用或停用負載平衡，保留啟用。

cues.en: Finally, you create your deployment group.
cues.zh: 建立 Deployment group。

cues.en: So of course, I'm gonna cancel because we haven't selected any EC2 instances, nor any scaling group, but once again, just showing you the steps here.
cues.zh: 當然我取消，沒選 EC2、群組，只展示步驟。

cues.en: So let's discard this, and now finally, assuming we have our deployment group, well, our last step is to create, finally, the deployment, okay?
cues.zh: 捨棄，假設已有群組，最後建立部署。

cues.en: So you go to deployments here, and then you click create deployment, and there you go.
cues.zh: 到 Deployments、Create deployment。

cues.en: That's what I was telling you.
cues.zh: 就是剛說的。

cues.en: A deployment needs to belong to a deployment group.
cues.zh: 部署需屬於群組。

cues.en: So here you would select, of course, the deployment group that you just created, then you choose a revision type between whether your application is stored in Amazon S3
cues.zh: 選剛建立的群組，再選 Revision type，應用放 Amazon S3，

cues.en: or in GitHub, okay?
cues.zh: 或 GitHub。

cues.en: Then revision location, well, here, you will enter the S3 bucket where you wanna store your application.
cues.zh: Revision location，填存放應用的 S3 位置。

cues.en: Then deployment description, you can give it a description if you want, but it's optional.
cues.zh: 部署描述，選填。

cues.en: Additional deployment behavior settings, all optional as well, but basically, you can configure what happens in case of an event failure.
cues.zh: Additional deployment behavior settings 都選填，可設定事件失敗時行為。

cues.en: And some more configurations here, totally out of the scope with the exam.
cues.zh: 更多設定超過考試範圍。

cues.en: And then there you go, you would finally create your deployment.
cues.zh: 最後建立部署。

cues.en: So of course, once again, I'm gonna cancel this.
cues.zh: 當然再次取消。

cues.en: We don't have all the elements, obviously, but now, there you go.
cues.zh: 沒有全部所需元素，但現在，

cues.en: You know the different steps on how to create a deployment in CodeDeploy, which concludes our CodePipeline series of hands-on tutorials.
cues.zh: 知道 CodeDeploy 建部署的步驟，CodePipeline 系列結束。

cues.en: So I look forward to seeing you in the next hands-on tutorial, and until then, enjoy machine learning with AWS.
cues.zh: 期待下一堂實作見，在那之前，享受 AWS 機器學習的樂趣吧。
